task: Penthouse 22 DAY and SUNSET lighting variants
input_method: Original JPG emitted inline with functions image; built-in image_gen called with num_last_images_to_include: 1 and no local-path argument.

assets.prompt:
Image1 is the edit target, preserve skyline composition, change only lighting.
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: Penthouse 22 exterior skyline background, Tokyo DAY mode.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole edit target, the supplied original DARK Tokyo skyline. Edit that image directly.
Primary request: Change only lighting, shadows, sky, and weather/atmosphere to create the DAY lighting variant.
Style/medium: Preserve the original architectural concept-art aesthetic, surface detail, rendering character, and level of realism.
Composition/framing: Preserve the exact original camera position, viewing direction, perspective, focal length, horizon, crop, landscape framing, and every object's silhouette, scale, spacing, and geometry. Keep Tokyo Tower exactly right of center, the distant slender tower near the far left, every high-rise and foreground roof, the elevated roadway, trees, mountain silhouette, and horizon at their exact original positions and proportions.
Lighting/mood: Bright natural blue sky with softly sunlit city facades and believable midday daylight. Use natural blue skylight, soft neutral sunlight, realistic daylight shadows, and gentle atmospheric depth. Turn off all artificial illumination: no neon, no glowing building windows, no illuminated landmark floodlights, and no glowing streetlights. Facade windows remain in place as unlit architectural surfaces with natural sky reflections. Remove stars and nighttime glow; water, if present, reflects the daylight sky.
Constraints: Keep all existing architecture and landmarks unchanged; do not invent, remove, relocate, resize, or redesign buildings or bridges. Preserve streets, terrain, foliage, shoreline, and water geometry. Exterior only: no room interiors, foreground windows or window frames, glass overlays, balconies, or interior furnishings. Existing facade windows must retain their geometry. No people added, no text, labels, logos, or watermarks. No panels, collage, borders, or comparison layout.
Output: Exactly one full-bleed PNG image, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 pixels.
